// booking target: What you want to book. Override any of these on the command line, e.g.  node book.js --date=2026-07-18 --court="Court 3" --time="19:00"
// behavior: headless=false shows the browser (recommended). confirm=false is a DRY RUN that stops before the final booking. slowMoMs slows actions so you can watch.
// selectors: Text/patterns the script clicks. These are best-guess defaults for hacomono. Run once in dry-run with the browser visible; if a step can't find its target, copy the real button text here. Japanese defaults are included as fallbacks.

selectors.loginSubmit: button:has-text("Log in"), button:has-text("ログイン"), button[type=submit]
